Annotations.description: Annotations maps metadata keys to implementation- or system-specific values.

Label.description: A label value that can be either a single string or an array of strings.

Labels.description: Labels maps each metadata key to a set of values.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the object's human-readable name.

labels.description: Labels contains metadata associated with the object.

annotations.description: Annotations contains implementation- or system-specific metadata.

Metadata.description: Metadata identifies and describes an OpenSLO v1 object.

type.description:
Type identifies the implementation-defined metric-source type.
When [SLIMetricSource.MetricSourceRef] is set, OpenSLO infers Type from the referenced [DataSource].

spec.description: Spec contains source-specific query or metric-retrieval configuration.

SLIMetricSource.description: SLIMetricSource identifies a metrics backend and supplies the configuration needed to retrieve a metric.

SLIMetricSpec.description: SLIMetricSpec defines one query used to read metric data for an SLI.

counter.description:
Counter reports whether the queried good, bad, and total metrics are monotonically increasing.
It has no effect when Raw is used.

good.description: Good supplies the numerator for a good-over-total ratio.

bad.description: Bad supplies the number subtracted from Total for a failure-based ratio.

total.description: Total supplies the denominator for a Good- or Bad-based ratio.

rawType.description: RawType selects whether Raw is interpreted as a success or failure ratio when Raw is used.

raw.description: Raw defines a query for a precomputed success or failure ratio.

SLIRatioMetric.description: SLIRatioMetric defines an indicator from good divided by total or (total minus bad) divided by total.

thresholdMetric.description:
ThresholdMetric defines a query that returns raw values.
[SLOObjective.Operator] compares each value with [SLOObjective.Value].

SLISpec.description: SLISpec defines the query or queries used to calculate an SLI.

description: SLI defines a derived reliability indicator and the queries used to calculate it for an SLO.
